method: Seven enabled recurring sources read live using the existing normal adapters, empty known-announcement lists, anonymous robots-aware project Client. No SQLite writes.
No Tavily requests, Facebook fetching, paid APIs, credentials, or cookies. PIA candidate probed once with the same Client and blocked at robots.
Publication dates are publisher metadata or explicitly attributed historical evidence. They never substitute for collector first_seen.
Earliest retained normal verification first_seen comes from persisted checked-in reports; production observations are separately read from existing SQLite in read-only mode. No timestamp backdating.
Date-only lead times are differences of Asia/Manila calendar dates, not invented midnight instants or guaranteed registration opportunities.

Additional retained normal SQLite run /tmp/ctfinder-index-live-yxdz5msd/events.sqlite3 contains earlier UP Manila/HTB/AWS observations. Its first_seen equals job start, so preserve that stored timestamp but label legacy precision and provide the completed-run receipt interval. Later response-stamped verification remains separately listed. This audit does not claim an exhaustive search of every temporary experiment.
